main:11.text: WMD is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. In Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, WMD was released on April 30th, 2019 first on PlayStation 4 and later on May 7th, 2019 for Xbox One and PC as part of the Black Ops Pass. In Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, WMD was added on March 17th, 2022 update.
